bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for a statue commemorating the life of Charlie Kirk, who was assassinated in Utah on September 10, 2025.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; STATUE OF CHARLIE KIRK. +]

[+$25,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to design and construct a statue of Charlie Kirk to be placed on the university's Twin Cities campus. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for a statue commemorating the life of Charlie Kirk, who was assassinated in Utah on September 10, 2025.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; STATUE OF CHARLIE KIRK.

$25,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to design and construct a statue of Charlie Kirk to be placed on the university's Twin Cities campus.
additions: $25,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to design and construct a statue of Charlie Kirk to be placed on the university's Twin Cities campus.
